description: This file defines the MultimediaMessagePdu class, representing a multimedia message in the PDU format, including methods to access and modify message headers and body.

classes.name: MultimediaMessagePdu
classes.description: Represents a multimedia message using PDU format, providing methods to access and modify headers and message body.

methods.name: MultimediaMessagePdu
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes a new instance of MultimediaMessagePdu.

methods.name: MultimediaMessagePdu
methods.description: Constructor with headers and body parameters, initializes a new instance of MultimediaMessagePdu with specified headers and message body.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the message body of the multimedia message.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the message body of the multimedia message.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the subject of the message.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject of the message, may throw NullPointerException.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the recipients of the message.

methods.name: addTo
methods.description: Adds a recipient to the message.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the message priority, may throw InvalidHeaderValueException.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date of the message as a long integer.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the message in seconds.
